final: WITH rating_daily_rate AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_daily_rate FROM film WHERE rental_rate IS NOT NULL AND rental_duration IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_daily_rate) AS overall_avg FROM rating_daily_rate), above_avg_ratings AS (SELECT avg_daily_rate FROM rating_daily_rate WHERE avg_daily_rate > (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall_avg)) SELECT AVG(avg_daily_rate) AS avg_per_day_of_above_avg_ratings, AVG(avg_daily_rate) - (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall_avg) AS how_far_above_average FROM above_avg_ratings
